minor.issue: Claude occasionally splits Devanagari characters across multiple TextDelta frames (e.g. 'स' and 'र' as separate frames). Works fine for text rendering (client concatenates) but combined with the SSE-framing bug means the JSON block is even more fragile.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the SSE-framing bug above, the frontend cannot reliably receive/parse the {"action":"navigate","route":"/invoices"} JSON block emitted by Claude. Ghost-User navigation via voice/chat will therefore silently fail on multi-line tool blocks even though the LLM is producing correct output. Backend testing agent did not test the UI here (backend-only run), but flagging for frontend regression once the SSE bug is fixed.

action_items:
Fix SSE framing in /app/backend/server.py::assistant_chat (line ~851). Recommended: for each TextDelta, emit each newline-separated segment as its own SSE frame, e.g. `for seg in event.content.split('
'): yield f'data: {seg}
'; yield '
'` (SSE spec: multiple data: lines then blank terminator). This preserves multi-line JSON tool blocks and keeps existing clients working.

After fixing SSE framing, re-run test_iter21_auth_audit_assistant.py::TestAssistantChat::test_navigation_intent_returns_json_action against the frontend Assistant screen to confirm the Ghost-User navigation flow works end-to-end.
Optional: Add a `X-Entry-Source` echo in bullion PUT responses (currently only stamped on create, not preserved on update) — low priority, review request only mandates it on create.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1123 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting auth/bullion/assistant/wingman/proxy routers into modules under /app/backend/routers/.

auth.py:81 — the module-level `_DUMMY_HASH` is computed at import time (bcrypt rounds=default). Fine for now but note: `auth_login` at server.py:134 hashes `"dummy-timing"` on every failed login (not using _DUMMY_HASH), which does extra work and slightly leaks timing when the user doesn't exist. Consider `_DUMMY_HASH` reuse.
server.py:1080-1095 — proxy audit injection silently swallows json.JSONDecodeError. Good defensive coding, but a warning log would help debug why some proxied requests don't get audit stamps.

server.py:189-190 — PATCH /auth/users allows updating `role` field; the code accepts any string. Should validate against Role enum to avoid accidentally setting an unknown role that then locks the user out of RBAC checks.
MongoDB `_id` correctly excluded from bullion responses via `_clean_mongo_id` (server.py:247).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth/audit/assistant surface is solid (25/25 tests green). The one open issue is the SSE-framing bug on /api/assistant/chat (see backend_issues.critical) — it breaks JSON tool-block delivery to any spec-compliant SSE client. Once the main agent applies the fix suggested in action_items, re-run test_iter21_auth_audit_assistant.py to confirm nothing regresses.
